_note: Copy to lsp_servers.json and adapt. Any value in command/args, env, workspaceRoot, initializationOptions or settings may reference an environment variable as ${NAME} (or ${NAME:-fallback}); it is expanded when the file is read, using the process environment including everything in .env. Only the braced form is special, so a bare $ stays literal. An unset name is left as written and reported as a validation note.

vue.label: Vue
vue._note: Volar delegates TypeScript semantics to its client over the private 'tsserver/request' protocol; core/lsphub (features.py answering via tsserver.py) answers _vue:projectInfo with the workspaceRoot's own tsconfig/jsconfig, which is what unblocks every other request. It does not run a tsserver, so <script> type errors come from the 'typescript' server, not from this one. Needs web/node_modules/typescript and a matching --tsdk.
